description: Market state for BTC, ETH, SOL or HYPE in one call: spot and the perp's basis against the Hyperliquid oracle, realized vol 7d and 30d, funding with its 30-day z-score, open interest and its changes, the top Hyperliquid accounts' net-long share, liquidations 1h and 24h by side, Fear and Greed, the next FOMC or CPI release, and flags with stated thresholds. Every part carries its source and as-of time; a part we do not hold is null with a reason. When nothing of the market itself could be built it answers 503 and is never billed. Costs 0.02 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Arc).
